title: Cambridge IGCSE & A Level Pseudocode Compiler: a browser-based interpreter, practice and exam platform for Cambridge pseudocode
description:
A browser-based interpreter for the pseudocode of Cambridge IGCSE Computer Science (0478/0984/2210) and Cambridge International AS & A Level Computer Science (9618). One superset ANTLR4 grammar covers both syllabuses, and an async tree-walking interpreter runs entirely client-side with student-friendly parse and runtime error messages. Around it sit autograded practice questions, timed exam simulation, a flowchart builder that converts drawings to runnable pseudocode, a sequenced Paper 2 course, and teacher classes with assignments and progress tracking.

Live at pseudocode-compiler.sherlemious.com. Source: github.com/Sherlemious/IGCSE-Pseudocode-Online-Compiler. Copyright (c) 2026 Abdelrahman Mohammed, all rights reserved; files are not distributed through this record.
